# Ranjan Sarkar — Creative Lead, Production Design to Execution

> Indore, India. Twelve years of retail merchandise working experience:
> advertising, branding, creative, designing, execution. 10,000+ retail
> signage units, 150+ identities built, 15+ sectors served. Freelancing
> as ArtViSiON Production Design; earlier Creative Director at BrandSutra
> Media Convergence.

This site is a single-page cinematic portfolio: five service decks with
real process evidence (shop drawings, workshop photos, install logs),
a scroll-scrubbed turntable of the designer, and a downloadable résumé.

## Key facts
- Services: Advertising (event design), Branding (national retail rollout),
